<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pub "publisher">
  <!ENTITY ent "Standard Entity Reference">
  <!ATTACHMENT xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns" ns:id="123">
]>

    ]]>

</catalog>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<?target-pi data="Processing instruction payload"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Root Entity">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; Expanded">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<root xmlns="http://xml.org/root" xmlns:custom="http://xml.org/custom">
  <!-- Comment wrapping entity reference and namespace usage -->
  <custom:child>
    <?custom-pi action="process"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with entities and attributes &extended;
    ]]>
  </custom:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY stock "In Stock">
  <!ENTITY status "&stock; - Ready">
  <!ENTITY % dtdAttr "CDATA #REQUIRED">
  <!ATTLIST item code %dtdAttr;>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://schema.org/inv" xmlns:loc="http://schema.org/loc">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment block -->
  <loc:item code="A-100">
    <?loc-pi status="active"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Item details: &status; <tag>safe</tag>
    ]]>
  </loc:item>
</inventory>
```

<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref "External Reference">
  <!ENTITY compound "&ref; & More">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "doc.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:doc="http://xml.org/doc/ext">
  <!-- Section comment explaining namespaces and structures -->
  <doc:section>
    <?doc-pi render="full"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw text data block with entities: &compound;
    ]]>
  </doc:section>
</document>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY rec "Record Data">
  <!ENTITY fullRec "&rec; Complete">
  <!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://xml.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://xml.org/archive/meta">
  <!-- Archive description comment block -->
  <meta:meta>
    <?meta-pi action="verify"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Meta archive payload containing entity &fullRec;
    ]]>
  </meta:meta>
  <record>&fullRec;</record>
</archive>
